Subject: Re: SLA credit request — ops calc and evidence (internal)

Hi team — I pulled the monitoring window and ran the standard SLA formula. Notes below and I’ve attached the raw uptime log and the calc workbook.

Summary of inputs
- Month: May 2026 (30 days) -> total minutes = 43,200
- Contracted SLA: 99.95% uptime
- Allowed downtime (0.05% * month) = 21.6 minutes
- Incident window provided: 2026-05-28T02:10:00Z to 2026-05-28T05:20:00Z -> 190 minutes of observed unavailability (we rounded to nearest minute after correlating health checks and request failures)
- Excess downtime = observed - allowed = 190 - 21.6 = 168.4 minutes

Credit methodology (per contract)
- Policy: Pro-rata credit = (excess_downtime / total_minutes_in_month) * monthly_commitment_amount
- Lumina reserved monthly commitment on prod-west: $220,000 (billing record C-9821)
- Calculation: (168.4 / 43200) * $220,000 = $857.56 -> round to nearest cent

Attachments included: uptime_log_20260528.csv (sampled health checks), sla_calc_lumina_may2026.xlsx (calc sheet with formulas and per-region breakdown).

Recommendation: Issue a credit memo for $857.56 and apply as an invoice offset on the next billing cycle unless customer requests a direct refund.

Lauren
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
